summary: No Forest Service page exists for this site: it is not on the Chippewa NF camping page's campground list, and none of the 22 dispersed-site maps (2025 index) covers Six Mile Lake. Only aggregator reports (2023: about 8 primitive sites, a vault toilet, a boat launch, free, 14 days). No groups changed; inclusion is aggregator-only and flagged.
flags: INCLUSION (weak, reviewer to decide): the only evidence is aggregator listings. Campendium 2023 reports: 'Only about 8 sites, vault toilet and a boat launch ... Couple miles off US 2 east of Bena, MN. Free.' and 'A boat access/launch ramp, 8 primitive sites, one pit toilet. 14 days, free camping. We stayed in 2 minivans.' A 2024 Dyrt review (search snippet, not read) says 'About 6 spots'. No reporter gives an RV length; no source shows a rig over ~20 ft fits. The Forest Service does not list it among its developed campgrounds and its 2025 dispersed-camping map index has no map over Six Mile Lake. Treat as unconfirmed by the agency.
SITES: stored count 12 is above every report (6-8); not changed, since no agency count exists.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: the pin (on the NE shore, just N of the private resort) and the spurs east of it are under continuous canopy on Esri z19 imagery; nothing on open ground within ~50 m of the lake.
